outcome: Systolic and diastolic blood pressure percentiles
cohort: 320 term and preterm newborns between 26 and 42 weeks gestational age born between 2015-2017 at a tertiary Iranian hospital.
finding: Term neonates had higher blood pressure than preterm neonates, and neonates delivered vaginally had higher blood pressure than those delivered via cesarean section.
mod_finding: Neonates delivered vaginally had higher mean blood pressure values than neonates delivered via cesarean section.
